entity_types.name: CONTRACT
entity_types.label: 合同
entity_types.description: 具有明确名称或编号的合同、协议、订单或补充协议

entity_types.name: ORGANIZATION
entity_types.label: 合同主体
entity_types.description: 甲方、乙方、采购人、供应商及其他签约机构

entity_types.name: PERSON
entity_types.label: 人员
entity_types.description: 法定代表人、联系人、经办人或授权代表

entity_types.name: AMOUNT
entity_types.label: 金额
entity_types.description: 合同总价、付款金额、保证金或违约金

entity_types.name: DATE
entity_types.label: 日期
entity_types.description: 签订、生效、交付、验收或付款日期

entity_types.name: CLAUSE
entity_types.label: 合同条款
entity_types.description: 付款、交付、验收、保密、违约、解除等具有约束力的条款

entity_types.name: OBLIGATION
entity_types.label: 履约义务
entity_types.description: 合同主体必须完成的交付、服务、付款或协作义务

relation_types.name: PARTY_TO
relation_types.label: 合同主体
relation_types.description: 机构或人员是某合同的签约方或参与方

relation_types.name: HAS_AMOUNT
relation_types.label: 合同金额
relation_types.description: 合同或合同主体对应的金额

relation_types.name: EFFECTIVE_ON
relation_types.label: 生效日期
relation_types.description: 合同在某一日期签订或生效

relation_types.name: HAS_CLAUSE
relation_types.label: 包含条款
relation_types.description: 合同包含某项关键条款

relation_types.name: RESPONSIBLE_FOR
relation_types.label: 承担义务
relation_types.description: 合同主体承担某项履约义务
